intro.es: Practica horarios, pedidos y rutinas cotidianas con una lectura breve en inglés A1. La experiencia completa toma unos diez minutos.
intro.en: Practise times, orders, and daily routines with a short A1 English reading. The full activity takes about ten minutes.

mission.es: Descubre qué pide Emma, a qué hora llega y qué compra para después.
mission.en: Find out what Emma orders, when she arrives, and what she buys for later.

content.targetText: Emma usually arrives at the café at eight o’clock. She sits near the window and orders tea with milk. Today, the café is busy. A man is waiting at the counter, and two students are talking about school. Emma reads a short message from her sister. At the end, she orders a sandwich for later. Then she leaves.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: Emma usually arrives at the cafe at eight o'clock. She sits near the window and orders tea with milk. Today, the cafe is busy. A man is waiting at the counter, and two students are talking about school. Emma reads a short message from her sister. At the end, she orders a sandwich for later. Then she leaves.

objectives.es: Identificar una hora y un pedido en un relato cotidiano.
objectives.en: Identify a time and an order in an everyday story.

objectives.es: Comprender la secuencia básica de una rutina.
objectives.en: Understand the basic sequence of a routine.

culturalNote.es: La situación es deliberadamente global y no representa una costumbre exclusiva de un país anglófono.
culturalNote.en: The situation is intentionally global and does not represent a custom unique to one English-speaking country.

spanishSpeakerNote.es: En inglés se usa at antes de una hora específica: at eight o’clock.
spanishSpeakerNote.en: Spanish speakers: English uses at before a specific time: at eight o’clock.

targetCanDo.es: Puedes comprender información concreta y una secuencia corta en un texto cotidiano sencillo.
targetCanDo.en: You can understand concrete information and a short sequence in a simple everyday text.

questions.prompt: What is the text mainly about?

correct.es: Correcto. Todas las acciones forman parte de la mañana de Emma en el café.
correct.en: Correct. All the actions are part of Emma’s morning at the café.

incorrect.es: Busca el lugar y la persona que aparecen durante todo el texto.
incorrect.en: Look for the place and person that appear throughout the text.

strategy.es: Para la idea general, busca elementos repetidos y no un detalle aislado.
strategy.en: For the main idea, look for repeated elements, not one isolated detail.

school.es: La escuela solo aparece en la conversación de dos estudiantes.
school.en: School appears only in the students’ conversation.

recipe.es: El texto menciona té, pero no explica una receta.
recipe.en: The text mentions tea but gives no recipe.

questions.evidence: Emma usually arrives at the café...

correct.es: Correcto. El texto dice “at eight o’clock”.
correct.en: Correct. The text says “at eight o’clock”.

incorrect.es: Vuelve a la primera oración y busca una expresión con at.
incorrect.en: Return to the first sentence and find a phrase with at.

strategy.es: Para localizar horarios, escanea números y expresiones de tiempo.
strategy.en: To find times, scan for numbers and time expressions.

questions.evidence: Emma usually arrives at the café at eight o’clock.

questions.prompt: What does usually mean in this text?

correct.es: Correcto. Usually significa normalmente o la mayoría de las veces.
correct.en: Correct. Usually means normally or most of the time.

incorrect.es: La palabra describe con qué frecuencia sucede la rutina.
incorrect.en: The word describes how often the routine happens.

strategy.es: Usa la rutina de la oración para reconocer el adverbio de frecuencia.
strategy.en: Use the routine in the sentence to recognise the frequency adverb.

questions.prompt: Emma orders a sandwich for later.

correct.es: Correcto. La última oración lo afirma directamente.
correct.en: Correct. The final sentence states this directly.

strategy.es: En verdadero o falso, compara cada parte de la afirmación con el texto.
strategy.en: For true or false, compare every part of the statement with the text.

questions.evidence: At the end, she orders a sandwich for later.

questions.prompt: Put the events in the correct order.

correct.es: Correcto. Ese es el orden del relato.
correct.en: Correct. That is the order in the story.

incorrect.es: Sigue el texto desde el principio hasta el final.
incorrect.en: Follow the text from beginning to end.

strategy.es: Busca marcadores como today y before, y sigue el orden del texto.
strategy.en: Look for markers such as today and before, and follow the text order.

questions.evidence: Arrives → reads a message → orders a sandwich.

prompt.es: Escribe 2–3 frases en inglés sobre tu rutina de la mañana.
prompt.en: Write 2–3 sentences in English about your morning routine.
